ShortDescription.Value: Custom city starting budget and milestones, add automatic budget support, and Convert Unlimited Money saves to normal.

Publish.LongDescription:
### Budget + Milestones
Custom City Start progression and budget options. Make it harder or easier to start a new city or maintain a city if you get in deep water.
#### City Start - Choose the starting money balance for the next loaded limited-money city. - Choose a higher milestone to unlock when the next city loads. - Choose if Milestone reward money is disabled or game default amounts. - Milestone rewards use the game's own milestone values and unlock events. - Add network demolition costs option.
#### Unlimited Money Converter - Convert a city created with Unlimited Money into normal limited-money budgeting. - Make a backup save first. The conversion cannot be undone by the mod.
#### Budget - these budget tools used to be in City Watchdog mod and spun off to this one. - Add or subtract a selected amount with hotkeys. - Optional Auto add can keep the city above a selected threshold.
#### City Start Options - Start city with any Milestone. Trains now! Set Initial money if you want Less for a challenge or more. - Quick handy info: hover over bottom menu money or population tooltips for instant info chart (faster than opening game's Info view). - Convert saves from Unlimited Money type to normal Limited Money.
**Hotkeys** - Shift+N = open/close panel (same as clicking on Top Left icon). - N = show/hide problem alert icons (same as clicking Show/Hide Icons button). - [ = Add Money, hold to repeat. - ] = Subtract Money, hold to repeat.
### Important Notes - Unlimited Money save: make a backup before converting the save. Mod cannot undo that conversion. Check mod's "show instructions". - No Harmony patch used; safer more reliable for patch days.
### Credits and thanks to supporters and testers River-Mochi, mod author
